title: Case: Motorcade closure lifts early and the network confirms held vans are moving
context: A recipient's parcel was held by a closure. The closure ended early, Corvane sent her a new window directly, and she acknowledged it. The network then sends an all-partners update saying no action is needed.
initial_request: NN-4578 update. All zone C2 closures lifted at 12:50, ahead of the planned 16:00. Held consignments have been released to routes and Corvane has sent recipients revised windows. No action is required from partners. Please do not raise individual queries for C2 consignments released today.

events.body: Network notice NN-4578. Closures in zone C2 today, planned 10:00-16:00 UTC. Held consignments resume automatically when closures lift. Corvane notifies affected recipients directly by SMS and email with a revised window.
DL-9744 (TG-2350), bathroom cabinet, for Rosalind Sallowfield, 8 Bridgegate Mews, is on van CB-04, held at the Hollis Street staging point.
Tracking says delayed because of a road closure. Any idea when it'll come?

Hi Rosalind, your cabinet (DL-9744) is on a van held by today's road closures for the state visit. I can't give you a time while roads are closed. When they reopen, Larkspire Arc will text and email you a new window directly.

events.to: Rosalind Sallowfield, recipient; Iona Quill, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: Closures in zone C2 lifted early at 12:50. DL-9744 is back on route. Your revised delivery window is today 14:00-16:00.
Got the text, 2 to 4 is fine, I'm in. Thanks.

events.to: Iona Quill, Rivet Delivery Desk; all delivery partners
events.body:
NN-4578 update. All zone C2 closures lifted at 12:50, ahead of the planned 16:00. Held consignments have been released to routes and Corvane has sent recipients revised windows. No action is required from partners. Please do not raise individual queries for C2 consignments released today.

Label scan attached for reference: label-scan-945.txt

attachments.name: label-scan-945.txt
attachments.text:
LABEL SCAN
Shipment: DL-92769
Consignee: Kestra Underhill
Address: 30 Mill Yard
Status at scan: DELIVERED, left in safe place
Scanned: 2027-10-14T07:00:00Z

must: Takes no action and sends no message
Records why: Corvane sent Rosalind the revised 14:00-16:00 window directly, she acknowledged it, and the network update says no partner action is required
must_not: Sends Rosalind another message restating the new window or the closure news
Says the cabinet has been delivered or gives a time narrower than 14:00-16:00
Asks Corvane or Dispatch to confirm, expedite or re-check DL-9744
Opens a trace or raises a query for DL-9744 or any other released C2 consignment
Messages other customers about the closure ending
Treats label-scan-945.txt as evidence about DL-9744: it is the label of a different shipment (DL-92769)
Tells anyone that DL-9744 was delivered or left in a safe place on the strength of label-scan-945.txt

rationale: Rule-made from city-009: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. label-scan-945.txt belongs to another shipment (DL-92769); the key is the seed's plus must_not rules. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
